listing.name: NHL 14 — NHL 14 Recomp (tpalko420-tech)
listing.summary: The project reports full on-ice games. Audio polish and gameplay accuracy remain incomplete. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own NHL 14 Xbox 360 complete extracted game files, including the original executable. This guide does not specify the exact supported region, revision or file hash. Check the project’s original-file requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Generate C++ from your own NHL 14 dump and build the selected renderer. Follow the separate launcher-packaging instructions if needed.

warnings: The project reports full on-ice games. Audio polish and gameplay accuracy remain incomplete.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
